summary.title: Flask by Example (Learning Path)
summary.one_liner: A 12-resource Real Python learning path that takes you from HTML, CSS, and Jinja basics through building, databasing, REST-API-ing, front-ending, and deploying Flask applications.
keywords: javascript front end for flask api
how do i build a web app with flask
how to deploy a flask app
takeaways: Build a scalable Flask project structure with logging, notification messages, and a database.
Create a REST API with Flask, Connexion, Swagger UI, SQLAlchemy, and Marshmallow over three parts.
Connect a single-page JavaScript front end to a Flask JSON API.
Deploy a Flask script and then a full Flask project to Heroku using Git and staging/production environments.
summary.summary: This learning path is a sequence of 12 Real Python resources (courses, tutorials, and a quiz) for Python developers who want to build web apps with Flask. It starts with HTML, CSS, and Jinja templating, then moves to a scalable Flask project with logging and a database. It continues with a three-part REST API series using Connexion, SQLAlchemy, and Marshmallow, followed by a JavaScript front end and deployment to Heroku. The page itself is an outline of these resources and does not contain the tutorial content. The listing points to a Todo List with Flask and RethinkDB project under web applications.
